mity: Alternative spelling of mitey (“infested with mites”).
mitzvah: Any of the 613 commandments of Jewish law.
mixed: simple past and past participle of mix
mixer: One who, or a device that, mixes or merges things together.
mixing: present participle and gerund of mix
mixologist: A person who creates cocktails, especially one considered an artist in that craft.
mixology: The art of combining various ingredients to create cocktails.
mixt: Archaic spelling of mixed, simple past and past participle of mix.
mizzenmast: The aftmost mast on a ship having three masts; the third-tallest mast on a full-rigged ship.
mizzle: To rain in very fine drops.
mizzled: simple past and past participle of mizzle
mizzles: third-person singular simple present indicative of mizzle
mizzling: present participle and gerund of mizzle
mizzly: Raining in the form of mizzle (“misty rain; drizzle”); drizzly.
